shots.note: HOOK: a gale at night; from the wave tops, the schooner heels toward the shore as lightning strikes
close-up on deck: a sailor's face as he sees the rocks
IMPACT: the schooner grounds, shudders, her foremast goes over in the spray
the big Invercauld breaking up under a wall of cliffs; tilt up the cliff as a mast falls
the chart: one island, two crosses at opposite ends
grey dawn: a Grafton man looks up at the wall of forest; crane over his shoulder
the match: an Invercauld man under the cliffs; tilt up 36 m of basalt
five men carry one spar up the beach; the camera backs away ahead of them
the hut goes up (time-lapse) while they hammer and bring thatch
one stirs the pot and hands a mug across the fire
all five round the fire in front of the finished hut; a slow arc
the chart: the camera flies the 40 km north from one cross to the other
nineteen men on the ledge under the cliffs; drift in from the surf
at rock level, a man drags himself out of the foam toward us
one reaches up for help; the other turns his back and walks away
straight down from the cliff top: nineteen figures drift apart
a man cuts a notch into the tally post; push-in on the marks
hammer on the gunwale, close
the camera rises: the finished boat with all five around her
over the shoulders of the two who stay, the boat stands out with three aboard
the boat, tiny on a mountain of grey water; the camera comes down to her
the camera tracks close along five faces; five gold figures count up
nineteen stand on the ledge; nineteen figures on screen
three men on an empty ledge; the count drops to three
the whole chart, both crosses and the route
one survivor alone in the dark, arms round himself, shaking
a sea bursts against the ledge and the cliff in a lightning flash
out of the dark, the one warm place: five men round a fire
close: one man puts a hot mug into another's hands; push-in to the end
